			}		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_ANDALUCIAN_STATESMAN_1_eventPicture
	}
	
	
	goto = advisorprovince
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
				}

					}
				}

		}

		clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_ANDALUCIAN_STATESMAN_2
